'''Salmorejo''', sometimes known as '''ardoria''' or '''ardorío''', is a traditional soup originating from Córdoba, [[Andalusia]], southern [[Spain]], made of [[tomato]], [[bread]], [[extra virgin olive oil]] and [[garlic]].<ref>{{Cite web |date=2020-06-05 |title=Gastronomía - Turismo en Campillo de Arenas |url=https://www.campillodearenas.eu/en/gastronomia/ |access-date=2024-07-02 |website=www.campillodearenas.eu |language=en-GB}}</ref> The salmorejo is served cold and may be garnished with diced Spanish [[jamón ibérico|ibérico ham]] and diced hard-boiled [[egg (food)|eggs]].<ref name="Tere">Teresa Barrenechea, Christopher Hirsheimer, Jeffrey Koehler, (2005), ''The cuisines of Spain: exploring regional home cooking'', New York, Ten Speed Press, {{ISBN|1-58008-515-6}}, pag. 67</ref>
